info.name: ElasticSearch <1.6.1 - Local File Inclusion
author: princechaddha
info.description: ElasticSearch before 1.6.1 allows remote attackers to read arbitrary files via unspecified vectors related to snapshot API calls.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability allows an attacker to read arbitrary files on the server, potentially leading to unauthorized access or sensitive information disclosure.
info.remediation: Upgrade ElasticSearch to version 1.6.1 or later to mitigate the vulnerability.

info.name: PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618/CVE-2026-109619) - Active Crash Detection
author: lcfr_hax
assetnote
princechaddha
s4e-io
info.description: PHP uses longjmp() for out-of-memory (OOM) errors to exit the current context and abort handling of the request. Some contexts may not properly account for this scenario and leave request memory in an uninitialized state before performing an allocation. The subsequent request cleanup procedure may read or branch on this memory. Multiple OOM strategies can consistently trigger this condition and lead to remote code execution (RCE).
info.impact: Affected PHP installations may allow an unauthenticated attacker to corrupt process memory, disclose sensitive worker memory, or achieve remote code execution as the web worker account.
info.remediation: Upgrade to PHP 8.2.35, 8.3.36, 8.4.27, 8.5.12, or later. PHP 8.1 and older are end-of-life upstream; upgrade to a supported branch or apply vendor backports for both CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619.

info.name: Apache Tomcat - HTTP Request Smuggling
author: 0x_akoko
info.description: Apache Tomcat from versions 8.5.0 to 8.5.93, 9.0.0-M1 to 9.0.81, lab-host-x-M1 to lab-host-x, and 11.0.0-M1 to 11.0.0-M11 contain an improper input validation caused by incorrect parsing of HTTP trailer headers, letting attackers craft headers to cause request smuggling, exploit requires sending malicious trailer headers.
info.impact: Attackers can perform request smuggling, potentially leading to cache poisoning, session hijacking, or bypassing security controls.
info.remediation: Upgrade to version 11.0.0-M12, lab-host-x, 9.0.81, or 8.5.94 or later.

info.name: Apache Tomcat - Cross-Site Scripting
author: yshahinzadeh
amirmsafari
info.description: Improper Neutralization of Script-Related HTML Tags in a Web Page (Basic XSS) vulnerability in the number guess example for Apache Tomcat. This issue affects Apache Tomcat: from 11.0.0-M1 through 11.0.22, from lab-host-x-M1 through lab-host-x, from 9.0.0.M1 through 9.0.118, from 8.5.0 through 8.5.100, from 7.0.0 through 7.0.109. Other versions that have reached end of support may also be affected. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 11.0.23, lab-host-x or 9.0.119, which fix the issue.
info.impact: Remote attackers can execute scripts in users' browsers, potentially stealing cookies or performing actions on behalf of users.
info.remediation: Upgrade to versions 11.0.23, lab-host-x, or 9.0.119 or later.
